name: quantus-cloud
description: Test stock ideas on real Korean and US data and turn an order sentence into a confirm card; orders go out only after you press confirm on the Quantus screen. Cloud trading-bot tools appear once Quantus Cloud opens to customers.

interface.longDescription: Sign in to Quantus once. Test a stock-picking idea over the longest period the data covers, look at Korean and US stock data, and turn an order sentence into a confirm card. Orders are never sent from chat: you press confirm on the Quantus screen in your own account. Cloud trading-bot tools (upload, start, logs, status, stop) appear once Quantus Cloud opens to customers. Past backtest results do not guarantee future returns, and Quantus does not give investment advice.
capabilities: Run cloud trading bots (once Quantus Cloud opens)
defaultPrompt: Backtest Samsung Electronics over the longest period.
Show me the financial snapshot of NVDA.
Make a confirm card to buy 1 share of Samsung Electronics.
